card.name: Period in Clinical Pharmacology 12.3 reference
card.fires_on: The decimal point between 12 and 3 in cross-references like "Clinical Pharmacology (12.3)" in drug label text, usually inside brackets after "see".

modes.label: Section 12.3 citation
modes.description: The period inside the section number 12.3 in a bracketed cross-reference to Clinical Pharmacology.

card.writes: It pushes toward the digit 0 or the word zero, which fits a decimal point that is followed by a number.
card.plain: It fires on the dot in the section number "12.3" when a label points the reader to the Clinical Pharmacology section.
